articles.title: PBMs Face New Legal Pressures for Fee Structure Transparency
articles.summary: Recent legal and regulatory developments are forcing pharmacy benefit managers to disclose greater details regarding their fee structures and pricing models. This shift directly impacts self-funded employers by increasing visibility into hidden costs and administrative fees. Plan sponsors should leverage this heightened transparency to renegotiate contracts and demand true pass-through pricing.
articles.source_line: Source: Snell & Wilmer; Sat, 14 Nov 2026 03:24:05 GMT

articles.title: CVS Health Argues GLP-1s Yield Net Savings Under $350 Monthly Threshold
articles.summary: CVS Health reports that obesity and diabetes medications like GLP-1s can deliver overall cost offsets for health plans if net monthly prices drop below $350. This pricing threshold provides a critical benchmark for self-funded employers struggling to sustainably manage surging specialty pharmacy spend and employee demand for weight-loss drugs. The finding underscores the pressing need for aggressive PBM negotiation and targeted pricing strategies to make GLP-1 coverage financially viable for plan sponsors.
articles.source_line: Source: Y100 WNCY; Sat, 14 Nov 2026 13:11:15 GMT

articles.title: CVS Health Highlights GLP-1 Price Reductions to Ease Employer Health Plan Costs
articles.summary: CVS Health notes that declining prices for GLP-1 weight-loss medications could help alleviate escalating cost pressures for self-funded employer health plans. This commentary directly addresses employers struggling to balance employee demand for weight-loss drugs with plan sustainability. PBM strategies around GLP-1 formulary management and pricing negotiations remain a critical concern for plan sponsors.
articles.source_line: Source: Traders Union; Sat, 14 Nov 2026 11:24:20 GMT

articles.title: Studies Highlight GLP-1 Access Gaps and Rising Obesity Costs
articles.summary: Recent studies presented at ObesityWeek emphasize the widening access gaps for GLP-1 medications and the escalating financial burden of obesity. For self-funded employers, these findings underscore the ongoing challenge of balancing comprehensive weight-loss benefit designs with cost containment strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: The American Journal of Managed Care; Sat, 14 Nov 2026 17:01:27 GMT

articles.title: CVS Analysis Finds GLP-1s Offset Costs at Sub-$350 Monthly Pricing
articles.summary: CVS Health research indicates that obesity-treating GLP-1 medications can generate net savings for health plans when priced under $350 per month by reducing downstream medical expenditures. This pricing threshold provides self-funded employers with a concrete benchmark for evaluating formulary coverage and cost-effectiveness of weight-loss drugs. As PBM strategies evolve, this insight helps plan sponsors better manage the financial impact of high-demand specialty pharmacy benefits.

articles.title: CVS Analysis Suggests GLP-1s Cost-Effective Below $350 Monthly Threshold
articles.summary: CVS Health reports that anti-obesity GLP-1 medications can generate overall net savings for health plans if the net price falls below $350 per month. This finding provides self-funded employers with a specific financial benchmark for evaluating the return on investment of covering high-cost weight-loss drugs. The insight helps plan sponsors weigh pharmacy expense against potential long-term medical cost offsets.
